findings.summary: FieldRegistry.default_view_expression wraps a bare date-like field name in MONTH(...), so passing 'Day of Adjusted Date' by name collapses the day column and the viz-in-tooltip filters to one mark per month.
findings.workaround: Pass the bracketed reference '[Day of Adjusted Date]', which is_expression() treats as an explicit binding and therefore leaves discrete.

findings.summary: Tableau serializes a highlight action with the sheets to leave out of the brush (the author's workbook says exclude="Date Chart"). add_dashboard_action computes that list from the sheets the action is not given, so naming the schedule as the target produces the inverse action.
findings.workaround: Declare the highlight action on the selector sheet itself, which yields exclude="Sport Selector" on a two-sheet dashboard and reproduces the author's intent of not brushing the schedule.
